1._section_summary: This abstract describes a single study (Study X) examining the association between consideration of cosmetic surgery, body appreciation, media influence, and demographics among 322 female university students. Participants completed the Consider subscale of the Acceptance of Cosmetic Surgery Scale, SATAQ-3, and the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS). Bivariate correlations revealed that consideration of cosmetic surgery was negatively correlated with BAS scores, age, and BMI, while multiple regression identified greater media influence, less body appreciation, and lower BMI as significant predictors.
